messages:
ava-docs: Heads-up from onboarding QA: our quickstart shows different env var names across language snippets (REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN) and the CLI generator still uses REDWOOD_API_KEY in Ruby. New users copy a snippet into the CLI and then can't auth.

noah-cli: Oof, that explains a bunch. The CLI templates are stashed in templates/quickstart/* and the language mapping got out of sync after we renamed env vars last quarter. I'll update the generator to expose a canonical env var (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and language aliases.

leo-support: Two tickets today: "can't authenticate using README snippet" and "token env var mismatch between examples". Users expect copy/paste to work. Can we also add an explicit one-liner in each snippet noting which env var(s) the example supports?

ava-docs: Proposal: canonical env var = REDWOOD_API_KEY. For each language snippet, add a small comment at the top: `# Uses REDWOOD_API_KEY (or set REDWOOD_KEY as alias)`. Also update the self-serve signup email and the playground embed which still shows older names.

ci-bot: I've opened docs issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1523 to canonicalize env vars and added a CI check that compares the generated template output to the README snippets. If they diverge, docs deploy will fail.

doc-lint: Added a lint rule to flag inconsistent env var names inside the same README file and to ensure code examples include auth header lines.

noah-cli: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/pull/237 updates templates, adds alias mapping, and modifies the generator tests to assert the snippet contains `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

leo-support: Can we also include a troubleshooting blurb: "If you see 401, check env var names and header - prefer Authorization: Bearer <token>". A short copy/pasteable troubleshooting snippet would be great.

ava-docs: Good call. I'll add that and a tiny example showing how to export the canonical var for each shell:
```bash
# POSIX
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="..."

# PowerShell
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = '\'...'\'
```

noah-cli: Once merged I'll trigger a docs snapshot and bump the quickstart template version. Also updating the signup email and the playground embed.

ci-bot: Linked issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1523 assigned to @ava-docs and @noah-cli.
